Your employees' wellbeing, looked after on the ground

Far from home, small things matter: a stocked fridge on arrival, a gym membership, an appointment booked. We take care of them.

À la carte or as a full programme

Welcome and settling-in

Arrival groceries, a walk around the neighbourhood, help with everyday admin. Your employee feels expected from the first evening.

Concierge during the stay

Cleaning, laundry, bookings, deliveries, small emergencies: one number to call for everything that is not the job.

Sport and activities

Gym access, discovering Paris, team outings: what keeps balance and motivation on long assignments.

Family support

For expatriations and relocations: schools, childcare, helping the partner settle. A well-settled family means a focused employee.

A programme built for you

Every company and every employee is different. Anna, our head of premium services, builds the programme with you: a few à la carte services for a short assignment, full support for an expatriation. You decide what is included; we take care of the rest.

Sending people to Paris? Call us.

In ten minutes we will understand your needs and tell you what we can do. In English or French, no commitment.
